components.name: Outlined button
components.css: .ds-button { font:inherit; cursor:pointer; border:1px solid var(--green); border-radius:8px; background:transparent; color:var(--foreground); padding:10px 18px; min-height:44px; transition:background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-button:hover { background:var(--soft-green); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--green); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity:.55; cursor:wait; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button { transition:none; } }

components.name: Simulation chip
components.css: .ds-sim { display:inline-block; color:var(--muted); background:#edf0e7; font-family:var(--font-geist-sans),sans-serif; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.06em; border-radius:4px; padding:5px 7px; } .ds-sr { position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; overflow:hidden; clip-path:inset(50%); }

components.css: .ds-seat { color:var(--foreground); font-family:var(--font-geist-sans),sans-serif; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:14px; padding:28px; background:var(--paper); max-width:520px; } .ds-seat-heading { display:flex; align-items:start; justify-content:space-between; gap:14px; margin-bottom:36px; } .ds-seat-heading h3 { font-size:23px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:-.02em; line-height:1.3; margin:0; overflow-wrap:anywhere; } .ds-sim { color:var(--muted); background:#edf0e7; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.06em; border-radius:4px; padding:5px 7px; } .ds-status { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; font-size:27px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:-.025em; line-height:1.3; margin:0 0 8px; } .ds-dot { width:11px; height:11px; background:#427790; border-radius:50%; flex-shrink:0; } .ds-detail { margin:0; font-size:13px; line-height:1.7; color:var(--muted); min-height:44px; max-width:46ch; } .ds-facts { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:24px; padding:28px 0; margin:16px 0 0; border-top:1px solid var(--line); } .ds-facts dt { font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:8px; } .ds-facts dd { margin:0; font-size:15px; font-weight:500; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-facts div:last-child { text-align:right; } .ds-seat-footer { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); border-top:1px solid var(--line); padding-top:16px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } @media (max-width:760px) { .ds-seat { padding:24px; } .ds-seat-heading { margin-bottom:28px; } }

components.name: Home wordmark
components.html: Cues.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; font-family:var(--font-geist-sans),sans-serif; font-size:32px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.04em; text-decoration:none; color:var(--foreground); } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--green); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-brand { display:inline-flex; align-items:end; gap:3px; margin-right:10px; height:23px; } .ds-brand i { width:5px; height:15px; background:var(--green); border-radius:3px; } .ds-brand i:nth-child(2) { height:23px; } .ds-brand i:nth-child(3) { height:19px; } .ds-period { color:#5b7b43; }

components.name: Live connection indicator
components.description: Page-level connection health, separate from task state.
components.css: .ds-connection { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; flex-shrink:0; font-family:var(--font-geist-sans),sans-serif; color:var(--green); font-size:12px; padding-bottom:6px; } .ds-connection > span { width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--green); }

components.name: Connection notice
components.description: A flat paper notice explains interrupted updates.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-notice { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:20px; padding:22px; background:#fcf4e4; border-radius:12px; color:var(--foreground); font-family:var(--font-geist-sans),sans-serif; } .ds-notice h2 { margin:0 0 8px; font-size:18px; font-weight:500; } .ds-notice p { margin:0; font-size:14px; line-height:1.7; color:var(--muted); max-width:65ch; } .ds-reconnect { font:inherit; cursor:pointer; border:1px solid var(--green); border-radius:8px; background:transparent; color:var(--foreground); padding:10px 18px; min-height:44px; flex-shrink:0; transition:background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-reconnect:hover { background:var(--soft-green); } .ds-reconnect:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--green); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-reconnect:disabled { opacity:.55; cursor:wait; } @media (max-width:760px) { .ds-notice { align-items:start; flex-direction:column; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-reconnect { transition:none; } }

narrative.overview:
Warm paper, green ink and generous space give structured observations a familiar classroom setting. Status labels lead each seat card; small facts and timestamps support the teacher’s quick scan. The visual tone is calm, practical and attentive.

The system uses restrained borders and flat surfaces. Its identity comes from the cream canvas, compact three-stroke wordmark and carefully stepped typography. Connection health stays in the page heading, separate from each seat’s task status.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper surfaces and green ink.
Status-led cards with text alongside every status dot.
Quiet metadata and clear simulation labels.

rules.name: The Separate Signals Rule
rules.body: Connection health belongs in its own labeled indicator. It must not recolor a seat as though the student’s task state changed.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Preserve tonal surfaces and fine borders as the default grouping language.

dos: **Do** pair every task-state color with a readable label.
**Do** keep connection health separate from task status.
**Do** preserve SIM provenance labels and quiet timestamps.
**Do** retain visible keyboard focus and the reduced-motion fallback.
**Do** use flat paper surfaces, fine borders and space to group content.
donts: **Don't** style tracking loss as student failure.
**Don't** use color alone to communicate status.
**Don't** turn the simulation badge into an action control.
**Don't** add shadows or filled action variants while claiming they are part of this extracted system.
